content.short: Matrixswap is a decentralized vAMM-based perpetual swaps protocol on Cardano for high-leverage trading.
content.description: Matrixswap is a decentralized derivative trading protocol that utilizes a virtual Automated Market Maker (vAMM) to offer perpetual swaps on the Cardano blockchain. Unlike traditional AMMs, Matrixswap allows users to take long or short positions on various assets with up to 25x leverage, all while maintaining native custody. The vAMM model is designed to provide infinite on-chain liquidity, overcoming the common hurdles found in other decentralized derivative platforms. Additionally, Matrixswap includes a DEX aggregator that supports multi-token batch swaps to enhance capital efficiency.
